title: dualis: physics for simulated worlds, checked against closed forms
description:
A Rust workspace of sixteen crates: a kernel that knows conservation, integration, scheduling and sampling but no physics, ten domain crates built on it, and scene and view layers above. Every claim is checked against a closed form, an exact limit, a conservation law or a convergence rate rather than against a second implementation. Results are bit-for-bit reproducible across platforms, optimisation levels, WebAssembly and thread counts, with a pinned digest that says so.

Licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0, at your option. This record names Apache-2.0 because Zenodo stores exactly one licence and cannot express the choice; the authoritative statement is the license field of Cargo.toml and the two LICENSE files in the repository.
